title: Raw model intelligence commoditizes rapidly while operational judgment retains value
text: Foundational AI intelligence—raw cognitive synthesis, drafting, and pattern matching—is becoming commoditized and universally available. Defensible enterprise value resides in contextual judgment: knowing client-specific trade-offs, navigating regulatory edge cases, bearing delivery risk, and maintaining human accountability for outcomes when systems fail.
qualification: Venture thesis separating intelligence commodities from judgment moats; relies on conceptual definitions of judgment rather than audited workforce skill distributions.

public_locator.value: Intelligence is becoming a commodity; judgment is not. Judgment requires context, values, and accountability.
